audioreach based architecture.

Signed-off-by: Srinivas Kandagatla <srinivas.kandagatla@oss.qualcomm.com>

 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

index 5d3dbb6cb1ae..8ac91625dce5 100644

           - qcom,qcs8275-sndcard
